obligations.note: The new payment-advice integration is in controls/payments/asset-inventory.json with "owner": "" and no purpose. The exhaustive control test test_integrations_are_inventoried fails with ('payment-advice', 'no owner'), and no exception in the register covers INV-1 for payments.integrations.

The new endpoint is https://advice.fernbrook.example/v1 and transports.py is unchanged. The registered exhaustive control test test_integrations_use_tls passed in the change's CI run on the head commit.

Ticket CHG-24697 is standard and approved by change manager Erik Brandt on 2026-10-14, before the PR opened on 2026-10-15. Its components (payments.integrations, payments.controls-data) cover both touched paths.
Code review approval comes from Mara Costa, a payments change_approver who is not the author (Sofia Santos) under any of her addresses.
All approvals name the head commit fa3a7a3, which is the change's only commit.

The CI run on the head commit has result 'failure'. The JUnit report shows 2 of 172 tests failing, including the registered INV-1 control test test_integrations_are_inventoried and test_inventory_entries_have_owner_and_classification.
integrations.py is security_sensitive, and Kofi Mensah (security_reviewer) approved the head commit with a security_review.
The protected path controls/payments/asset-inventory.json changed. Bao Tran (control_owner, controls-office, outside the author's payments-eng team) gave a control_owner approval on the head commit.
The change touches only integrations.py and asset-inventory.json. No acceptance-ledger entry covers either file, so no earlier evidence lapses.

summary: The change registers a new outbound payment-advice integration, but its asset-inventory entry has an empty owner, which violates INV-1. The change's own CI run on the head commit failed on that point, so CHG-4 is not met either. Ticket, independent code review, security review and control-owner approval are all in order, and the new endpoint uses TLS. Because INV-1 and CHG-4 are refuted, the change is rejected.
